{{Top}}
[[File:Blanket.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] kneeling on a blanket.]]
A '''blanket''' was a large piece of fabric used for bedding, warmth, and protection from environmental elements. Blankets could be made from many different materials, including [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and animal fur,<ref name="JB">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Bounty]]''</ref> such as [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]],<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> [[grov]],<ref name="Specter">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> and [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]] fur.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref>

[[Thermal plastifoil survival blanket|thermal blanket]]<ref name="XIF">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> and [[Thermal plastifoil survival blanket|therma-blanket]]<ref name="GoFtH">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Hunger]]''</ref>)
*[[Thermosensitive blanket]]<ref name="TAS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
